newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Nordstrom & Thulin orders 2 tankers from Daewoo.
newsitem.headline: Nordstrom & Thulin orders 2 tankers from Daewoo.

text.p: Swedish shipping company Nordstrom & Thulin said on Thursday it had ordered two oil tankers of 158,000 tonnes each for about 800 million crowns.
The shipping company said in a statement that the order was made with the Daewoo shipyard in South Korea.
These tankers would be delivered in July and September of 1999.
Nordstrom & Thulin said it had also an option for a further tanker for delivery in the year 2000.
"These tankers are especially suitable for difficult water like the Baltic Sea," the company's managing director Anders Berg said in the statement.
Nordstrom & Thulin took a strategic decision earlier this year to increase its involvement in the tanker market at the expense of its dry cargo and ferry operations.
